newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Rural Press buys U.S. publishing group.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Rural Press buys U.S. publishing group.

text.p: Newspaper, magazine and radio company Rural Press Ltd said on Monday it has agreed to buy U.S. agricultural publishing group Farm Progress Group for US$56.9 million.
Rural Press said the agreement is for 100 percent of the issued stock of Farm Progress Holding Co Inc, from ABC Inc, an indirect subsidiary of the Walt Disney Co.

Farm Progress, which it described as America's largest agricultural information provider, publishes agricultural titles, operates farm shows, and has electronic database services, custom publishing and agricultural newsletters.
Rural Press said the purchase would be funded from cash flow and exiting bank facilities. It was projected to be earnings positive in the first year.

Managing director Brian McCarthy said the acquisition would provide further scope for expansion of Rural Press's Australian and New Zealand agricultural publishing, and lead to synergies and technology exchange.
The acquired titles would complement Rural Press's existing 13 state farm newspapers headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina.
Rural Press said Farm Progress derived most of its revenue from publications, which include 26 state titles and three national magazines.
